title: Regular equations for the diagonal of a standard-smooth affine chart
statement: Let $R\to A$ be a standard-smooth homomorphism of commutative rings of relative dimension $d>0$. Put $W=\operatorname{Spec}(A\otimes_R A)$ and let $\Delta:\operatorname{Spec}A\to W$ be the diagonal, defined by the multiplication map $A\otimes_R A\to A$. For every point $w$ in the image of $\Delta$, there is an affine open neighbourhood $U=\operatorname{Spec}B$ of $w$ in $W$ such that the kernel ideal of $\Delta^{-1}(U)\to U$ is generated by a $B$-regular sequence of length $d$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence].
